M-INHERITED-CONTEXT.Purpose: Inherited context propagation: register providers in the tree, resolve consumers to the nearest ancestor provider with shadowing, and rebind consumers through the generated _Update{Prop}FromAncestor seam.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: InheritedContextManager: provider registration, nearest-provider lookup, shadowing, consumer rebinding.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Emission of the consumer seam — owned by M-WIDGET-EMITTER (shared symbol, no cross parents).

Requirements.REQ-001: Lookup resolves to the nearest ancestor provider and shadows outer providers per S-WIDGETS.REQ-003.
Requirements.REQ-002: Consumer rebinding calls the generated Widget._Update{Prop}FromAncestor (M-WIDGET-EMITTER.REQ-002).

Inputs.IN-001: provider registration keyed by context type on a widget instance.

Outputs.OUT-001: resolved nearest context value for a consumer.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Mutates consumer widget properties during rebinding.

M-INHERITED-CONTEXT.Codemap: * `InheritedContextManager(widgetTree)` * `InheritedContextManager.RegisterProvider(provider, propertyName, behavior)` * `InheritedContextManager.SubscribeConsumer(consumer, propertyName, typeName)` * `InheritedContextManager.ReleaseInheritedContext(widget, propertyName)` * `InheritedContextManager` -> `WidgetTree.TraverseAncestors` => nearest provider * `InheritedContextManager` -> `Widget._Update{Prop}FromAncestor` : shared generated symbol
